body: internal/entitygraph/norngate wraps entitygraph.BuildAccuracyReports as a norn.Oracle - NORN's second real instantiation and the first with genuine production history: var/entity-graph/accuracy.ndjson has ~345K records, ~32.7K resolved (confirmed/refuted), unlike S141-02's EPS migration which had zero real historical grading decisions. Graded against a frozen, content-addressed snapshot of the resolved records (live file excluded per PRIME-101 section 5's frozen-eval requirement - 313K pending records are still resolving). cmd/norn-entitygraph-migrate bootstrap-promoted the current config/entity-graph-rules.json as the first entity_graph_rules artifact, run for real against the full 345K-record production dataset in ~3.8s. Real finding surfaced as a side effect, not investigated/fixed in this migration: overall precision is 11.9% across 32,664 resolved predictions, with abstention_outlier, cfo_departure, and family_control sitting at exactly 0% - flagged in BACKLOG.md as a follow-up candidate for a future data-quality pass. Disclosed limitation: Grade measures the current rules' real production track record, not a genuine candidate-vs-incumbent backtest, since re-running signal generation under a hypothetical alternate ruleset against historical raw filings would require a backtesting capability that doesn't exist yet. Investigated the GEE (GameEvolutionEngine) leg of S141-03 before attempting it: no such system exists anywhere in the codebase - only spec-table references (HQ-SPEC-PRIME-097's loop registry, PRIME-101) and a differently-shaped bot-genome mutation system in SHANKPIT (evolve_bot) with no external oracle and no gate/promotion mechanism. Disclosed as a real gap rather than building a new game-design engine under a 'migration' heading - that would be new-product work, not what S141-03 asked for. Also extracted GradeAndPromote (pkg/norn/promote.go, NORN repo) after writing the bootstrap-or-gate branch by hand for S141-02 and being about to duplicate it for S141-03 - refactored the EPS migration to use the shared helper too. 6 new tests in entitygraph/norngate, 5 new tests in NORN's promote.go, full workspace go build/go test green across all 7 modules. Commits: PRRJECT_FATBABY (entitygraph norngate + eps refactor), NORN (GradeAndPromote).
title: S141-03: entity-graph recon matcher migrated to NORN; GEE leg disclosed as unbuildable
